title: Quicksplice staffing delta sampler + owner clipboard
body:
Purpose:
Quick one-off to estimate near-term staffing delta for the next 10 business days across cross-functional owners. This is a fast-scratch inventory (not authoritative) to: 1) identify immediate gaps for weekend coverage and 2) produce a compact ownership clipboard for on-call handoffs and short-term surge shifts.

How to use this doc (notes to self):
- Use this as a live scratchpad that owners can update during morning sync.
- If a number is 'TBD' leave a comment with preferred fallback.
- This is intentionally lightweight: a quick yes/no + delta estimate + contact method.

Snapshot (2026-12-03 morning):
- Window: 2026-12-06 -> 2026-12-17 (10 business days, two weeks)
- Baseline headcount expected on duty (core rota): 18 FTE across Eng/Product/CS/SRE
- Anticipated additional need (micro-surge triggers): 2–6 FTE depending on incident footprint

Owner clipboard (compact table; update in-line):
Owner | Team | Role | Local availability (dates) | Delta ask (hrs/day) | Contact | Quick fallback
Evan Chu | product-ops | surge coordinator | 12/06–12/10 partial (0900–1400 PST) | +2 (00:00–04:00 token ops) | evan@redwood.ai | Maya T (backup)
Maya Thompson | eng-sre | on-call lead | 12/06–12/08 full | +1 (hand-off overlap) | maya@redwood.ai | Ravi M
Ravi Menon | solutions-eng | customer triage | TBD (12/09 tentative) | +0.5 | ravi@redwood.ai | Leila K
Leila Kaur | customer-success | escalation point | 12/06–12/17 limited mornings | +1 (AM triage support) | leila@redwood.ai | rotation pool
Jon Park | infra | GPU ops | 12/07–12/09 OOO | 0 (but reachable if needed) | jon@redwood.ai | infra-rotation

Quick delta math (very approximate):
- Baseline coverage capacity: 18 FTE * 6 hrs/day effective = 108 effective hours/day
- Projected micro-surge requirement: additional 10 effective hours/day => ~+2 FTE equivalent
- Conservative slack target: +3 FTE to account for cross-region handoffs and timezones

Open questions / unknowns to resolve before final handoff:
- Which customers have scheduled demos on 12/08–12/10? (impact on solutions-eng availability)
- Are there any planned infra maintenance windows that would reduce GPU ops availability?
- Is the cross-region on-call pool aware of potential elevated embedding costs this week?

Actionable next steps (short list):
1) By EOD 2026-12-03: owners to confirm availability inline and note absolute hard-blocks.
2) 2026-12-04 morning sync (10m): finalize +1 backup contacts and publish a compact Slack roster to #ops-coverage.
3) If net delta > +3 FTE: trigger capacity provisioning play (contact infra capacity bookers) and notify finance.
4) Add a one-line customer-impact note for any owner who expects >2x normal triage load.

Fallback & escalation flow (short):
- Primary owner unavailable -> contact listed backup -> if backup unavailable, ping #oncall-bridge + @product-ops on Slack.
- If GPU ops needed and Jon OOO, ping infra-rotation and escalate to SRE manager (Dalia Chen).

Signals to watch (fast heuristics):
- Inbound escalation threads in #cs-escalations > 3 in 2 hours -> bump to +1 immediate triage.
- 95th percentile latency for hosted-api endpoints increases by 20% -> page eng-sre.
- Embedding cost burn > expected by 15% day-over-day -> alert finance-runbook and product-ops.

Quick notes / heuristics (scratch):
- Prefer half-day shifts for cross-region coverage rather than full-day unless owner volunteers.
- Keep solutions-eng handoff window to 30 minutes overlap for continuity.
- Tag any last-minute swaps with reason (e.g., "demo", "PTO", "maintenance") for downstream reporting.

Mini retrospective template (to fill after window closes):
- Actual extra FTE used (sum hrs):
- Top 3 friction points:
  1) 
  2) 
  3) 
- Things to keep for next quicksplice:

Bottom line: this is a deliberately ad-hoc, minimal-lift clipboard to get cross-functional owners aligned quickly. If you copy this into a heavier sheet later, preserve the owner/contact/fallback columns and keep the delta ask as a single-number estimate (hrs/day).

Notes to self: If we go into an extended surge (more than 4 days > +2 FTE) convert to the longer-form surge roster and file a quick post-mortem in Confluence (link above).

-- Evan
